puzzles.title: Follow the fork through
hints: Check with the knight and attack the rook.
Look at Nd5+, then capture the rook after the reply.
puzzles.explanation: A forcing knight check gives time to take the rook. Always calculate the reply.

puzzles.title: Restrict the pinned knight
puzzles.explanation: The knight cannot move off the bishop's diagonal without exposing its king.

puzzles.title: Bring in the king before mating
hints: The king can take away the seventh rank.
Try Kg6+, then find a protected queen mate.
puzzles.explanation: King support removes escape squares. Several final queen mates are accepted.

puzzles.title: Use king opposition and the back rank
hints: Use your king to cover g7 and h7.
Kg6 forces ...Kg8, then Ra8 is mate.
puzzles.explanation: The king covers escape squares while the rook controls the back rank.

puzzles.title: King support and a reserve pawn move
hints: Start by moving the king to d5.
Follow Kd5, e5, e6, Kd6, e7 and promotion against the shown replies.
puzzles.explanation: This illustrative line uses king support and a pawn tempo. It is not proof against every possible defense.

puzzles.title: Uncover check and win the queen
hints: Move the knight to uncover the rook.
puzzles.explanation: Nc5 creates check and a second threat. Restart to practice another authored defense.
